description: This file defines a migration class for version 5.5.0 of the OrangeHRM system. It contains methods to modify the database schema, insert initial data, manage language strings, and setup workflows related to claim management features. It is part of the installer/migration system to upgrade or set up the database schema and seed data for this specific version.

classes.name: Migration
classes.description: This class manages database migration routines for version 5.5.0 of OrangeHRM, including schema changes, data insertion, language string management, and workflow setup related to claims.

methods.name: up
methods.description: Performs the database schema updates, data seeding, and configuration changes required for the 5.5.0 migration.

methods.name: getVersion
methods.description: Returns the version string of this migration ('5.5.0').

methods.name: modifyClaimTables
methods.description: Updates various claim-related tables to correct schema and data types.

methods.name: modifyClaimRequestCurrencyToForeignKey
methods.description: Converts currency field in claim requests to a foreign key constraint.

methods.name: changeClaimExpenseTypeTableStatusToBoolean
methods.description: Converts the status field in expense type table to boolean.

methods.name: changeClaimEventTableStatusToBoolean
methods.description: Converts the status field in claim event table to boolean.

methods.name: updateLangStringVersion
methods.description: Updates the language string version to the specified version.

methods.name: getLangStringHelper
methods.description: Returns an instance of LangStringHelper, initializing it if necessary.

methods.name: insertI18nGroups
methods.description: Inserts initial internationalization (i18n) groups related to claims.

methods.name: insertMenuItems
methods.description: Inserts a menu item into the database with specified parameters.

methods.name: getParentId
methods.description: Retrieves the ID of a menu item given its title and parent ID.

methods.name: getScreenId
methods.description: Retrieves the ID of a screen given its name.

methods.name: checkClaimExists
methods.description: Checks if a claim menu item already exists.

methods.name: insertWorkflowState
methods.description: Inserts a workflow state into the workflow state machine.

methods.name: removeMarketplaceTables
methods.description: Drops marketplace addon tables if they exist.

methods.name: updateI18nGroups
methods.description: Updates the group ID for specific language strings.

methods.name: deleteLangStringTranslationByLangStringUnitId
methods.description: Deletes translation entries for a specific language string unit ID.
